title: The density kx(2 − x) with k = 3/4
caption: The area under kx(2 − x) from 0 to 2 is 4k/3, which must be 1, so k = 3/4. The curve is symmetric about 1, so P(X < 1) = 1/2.
alt: Graph of f(x) = 0.75x(2 − x) on [0, 2], a dome with maximum 0.75 at x = 1; the area left of 1 is shaded.
description: Total area ∫ kx(2 − x) dx over [0, 2] = 4k/3 = 1 gives k = 3/4.
The dome peaks at x = 1 with height 0.75.
By symmetry the shaded half has area 1/2.
